== History ==
[c2] clan Capitals was founded on 10.July 2000 as a German Quake Clan by [[p4cman]] and iceman.
Famouse Quake III Arena clan with a skilled clan roster.
''Started to play Quake World in 2001 - just for fun and good old times''.
Going inactive around 2005.
